profile: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company developing melanocortin-4 receptor agonists for rare neuroendocrine diseases associated with hyperphagia and severe obesity. Its marketed medicine, IMCIVREE (setmelanotide), is authorized for certain rare MC4R pathway diseases, including Bardet-Biedl syndrome and specified genetic deficiencies. The company is also developing investigational medicines bivamelagon and RM-718 for hypothalamic obesity and related conditions.
